sessions.topic: Test residual-based CIFS, then adopt crossed color–texture swaps after the initial worst-domain gain falls short.
sessions.boundary_reason: The swapped CIFS configuration is adopted and released; the discussion shifts to feature-probe results and texture-defined labels.

sessions.topic: Assess original CIFS feature preservation and CIFS-Swap performance when texture defines the label.
sessions.boundary_reason: The CIFS probe and TextureLabel-8 evaluations conclude; a new cue-protection method is proposed.

sessions.topic: Test whether FACTOR-Guard protects essential texture without protecting correlated color, including at 95% agreement.
sessions.boundary_reason: The high-agreement stress test exposes excessive color protection, prompting a revised approach.

sessions.topic: Try texture-fixed recoloring and sweep its probability to reduce color protection at 95% agreement.
sessions.boundary_reason: The 50% setting meets the measured targets, leading to fresh-split validation.

sessions.topic: Validate 50% recoloring, address a failing split with adaptive 50%/75% recoloring, and release FACTOR-Guard v2.
sessions.boundary_reason: Adaptive recoloring is adopted and packaged; discussion shifts to spurious feature interactions.

sessions.topic: Evaluate and adopt COMBI-Guard for suppressing spurious conjunctions while retaining label-essential interactions.
sessions.boundary_reason: COMBI-Guard is released; a distinct rare-conjunction reweighting approach begins.

sessions.topic: Test RISK-Envelope under label noise and find that 2% rare conjunctions undermine its initial results.
sessions.boundary_reason: The rare-conjunction failure motivates a revised weighting method.

sessions.topic: Test loss trimming and count smoothing for rare, noisy conjunctions, including independent splits.
sessions.boundary_reason: An independent split falls short, prompting marginal shrinkage.

sessions.topic: Tune and ablate marginal shrinkage of conjunction weights.
sessions.boundary_reason: An ablation-cohort split falls short, motivating reliability-gated shrinkage.

sessions.topic: Evaluate reliability-gated shrinkage and blind-test its worst-domain gains.
sessions.boundary_reason: A blind split misses the gain threshold, motivating source-only swaps.

sessions.topic: Add color/background swaps to gated shrinkage and check whether predictive interaction probes remain accurate.
sessions.boundary_reason: A fresh split exceeds the permitted probe loss, prompting investigation of logit anchoring.

sessions.topic: Compare swaps with shape×texture-logit anchoring on matched splits and defer RISK-Envelope.
